brand.name: Modernité
entry.lead: Place Modernité solar glass and roof tiles on your own building, and see what they would generate, cost and return.
entry.scope: Available across the United Kingdom, Europe, Canada and Japan.
entry.stage_caption: Roof tiles and solar glass, modelled surface by surface.
location.title: Where is the building?
location.lead: Choose a region, locate the property and measure the footprint.
location.uk_detail: Typical homes from houses to apartments
location.map_notice: A Google Maps browser key enables live satellite imagery. Use the interactive fallback below to complete the design flow.
location.click_map: Click the fallback map to add footprint corners
location.trace_help: Click at least three corners; click the first point again to close the outline.
location.outside: This location is outside the selected region. Change the region or move the outline.
location.invalid_area: Please outline a single building between 5 and 3,000 m².
building.title: Choose the building form
building.lead: Select the closest archetype. Your measured footprint will override nominal dimensions.
building.conservatory_detail: A glass extension with a solar roof opportunity
products.title: Place solar surface by surface
products.lead: Assign Modernité products to roof planes, façades and additional structures.
products.colour_notice: Coloured tiles generate 70% of the black equivalent.
products.conservatory_notice: Conservatory side walls are non-generating and excluded from capacity.
energy.title: Your electricity use and prices
energy.lead: Your inputs determine the financial comparison; defaults are editable starting points, not tariff claims.
energy.tou: Time-of-use tariff — needed for the battery-only comparison
results.range_note: Generation is shown as a planning range, not a single promised figure.
results.monthly_caption: Figures are available below as an accessible table.
results.monthly_table: View monthly figures as a table
results.disclaimer: Quantities are design estimates from modelled geometry. A site survey is required before ordering.
assistant.title: Explain this assessment
assistant.subtitle: Report-aware assistant
assistant.q1: Why does my north-facing surface still generate?
assistant.q3: What does the incremental cost mean?
assistant.q4: Would a battery suit my usage pattern?
assistant.q5: Why is the coloured tile figure lower?
assistant.q6: What would change if I added the west façade?
map.select_location_lead: Choose a service territory, then move directly to satellite imagery to outline an existing roof, a building footprint, or open ground for a new proposal.
map.coverage_note: Highlighted countries are configured for this planning tool. In Europe, choose an individual country first; the Europe solar and building profile is then applied.
map.site_lead: Locate a property with an address, your current position, or a precise map pin.
map.located_help: The map and all following geometry now use this project location.
map.address_help: Search within the selected country, or use your current position.
map.place_pin: Place a pin on the map
map.trace_roof_detail: Click the roof corners to measure an existing roof or building footprint.
map.trace_ground_detail: Outline a new-build or ground-mount proposal area.
map.inspect_facade_detail: Open a nearby outdoor road view and mark elevation zones.
building.library_lead: Select the closest starting point, then adjust its geometry in the live 3D model.
building.orbit_hint: Drag to orbit · scroll to inspect
footer.method: Product area, irradiance and empirical coefficients remain visible.
entry.title: Trace your roof. See your solar potential.
entry.lead_simple: Start with a real site, trace the usable surface, choose a building model, and receive a clear annual-generation range.
entry.assurance: Satellite trace · simple inputs · explained result
entry.planning_note: Planning result · not a construction quote
location.simple_lead: Use one world map. Click an illuminated country or select it from the list, then continue straight to satellite imagery.
location.panel_body: European countries are selectable individually. Canada, Japan and the United Kingdom use their own local building profiles.
coverage.title: Where is your project?
coverage.lead: Zoom and pan the map, then click a highlighted country. France, Hungary, Croatia and the rest of the supported European territories are selectable.
roof.title: Measure the usable roof.
roof.lead: Find the property, click around the visible roof edge, and the area updates after the third point. Click the first corner again to close the outline.
roof.no_address: Search an address or use your current location.
roof.find_help: Search stays inside the selected country.
roof.trace_help: Click each corner. Click the first point again to close the polygon.
roof.no_save: The outline is applied immediately; no naming, saving or confirmation step is required.
map.not_found: No precise address found. Try another postcode or use your current location.
map.site_mode: Click the satellite map once to set the project point.
map.trace_mode: Click roof corners. Click the first corner again to close the outline.
map.street_mode: Street View is open. Use the arrows inside the panorama to move along the road.
map.satellite_ready: Satellite imagery is ready. Search a site, then trace the usable roof.
map.close_hint: The yellow trace is still a draft. Close it to apply the measured roof area.
map.area_ready_help: The boundary is already applied. You can add more points, undo, or continue to the building type.
map.trace_help_live: Click around the roof edge. Area updates automatically after the third corner.
map.panorama_unavailable: No outdoor Street View was found near this point.
building.simple_lead: Start with a familiar type. The traced roof area remains the measured input; dimensions and pitch are editable model assumptions.
building.additions_help: Add only if the property has it.
building.refine_help: These settings are visible because they affect the roof model and generation estimate.
building.roof_product_lead: Start with the roof material. Façade, glass, railing and additions are available as separate surface families.
building.no_surface: This surface family is shown as a product reference. Detailed façade/window quantities can be added during survey.
review.title: One more detail, then calculate.
review.lead: The building and product choice create the system model. Add annual electricity use to put the result in context.
review.annual_question: How much electricity do you use each year?
review.method_note: Uses the supplied empirical temperature-rise coefficients, product power density, irradiance components and a 90% AC-output factor.
results.calc_temperature_detail: Documented direct and diffuse/reflected empirical coefficients.
results.calc_output_detail: Product density, temperature correction and 90% AC-output factor.
map.closure_target: Click the cyan ✓ at the first corner, or use Close outline.
map.facade_help: Pan to the elevation you want, then click the facade overlay to select it.
map.facade_selected: Selected facade will open in solar materials.
roof.facade_detail: will be available in the façade solar materials section.
map.pegman_hint: Drag the official Google Pegman onto a blue road line to open Street View.
building.form_lead: Choose a starting form, then adjust the dimensions and solar tilt. The 3D study updates as you work.
building.live_model_help: Orbit the model to inspect the form, roof pitch and BIPV surfaces.
structures.title: Add additional structures
structures.lead: Choose any structures present at the site. Each one keeps its own editable dimensions.
structures.none_help: Continue with the main building only.
structures.parameters_help: These settings apply only to the selected structure.
structures.select_to_edit: Choose a conservatory, carport or entrance canopy to edit its dimensions.
structures.conservatory_detail: Glazed extension with a photovoltaic roof.
structures.carport_detail: Clear-span vehicle shelter with a solar canopy.
structures.canopy_detail: Compact solar shelter over an entrance or terrace.
library.roof_lead: Solar tiles and slates for the measured roof surfaces.
library.facade_lead: Opaque and light-transmitting solar façade modules.
library.window_lead: Photovoltaic glazing for windows and rooflights.
library.railing_lead: Solar glass balustrades for balconies and terraces.
library.structure_lead: Solar glass and canopy products for selected structures.
products.library_lead: Use the library by surface type. Your selections remain independent, so roof, façade, glazing, railings and structures never overwrite one another.
products.live_model_help: Click a surface in the 3D study to open its matching library.
building.roof_semantics: Roof slope is limited to 70°. A 90° solar surface is configured as a façade, not a roof.
